names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 28 decembrie, «Sfântul Simon Izvorâtorul de mir, ctitorul Mănăstirii Simonos Petras», with the epithet and the office left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Δεκεμβρίου, «Όσιος Σίμων ο Μυροβλήτης κτήτορας της Ιεράς Μονής Σιμωνόπετρας», with the rank, the by-name and the monastery left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s second heading for 28. децембар ст. ст., „Преподобни Симон Мироточиви.“ — «Преподобни» is the rank `venerable` the folder carries, and «Мироточиви», the myrrh-streaming, is an epithet and not a rank, so it is kept: §6 asks for the fullest form the calendar gives. MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS WRITTEN: neither the full string nor the bare «Симон» has any other holder in the corpus, so the epithet costs nothing and keeps the form the book’s own. The monastery, Симоно-Петра, is in the body and not in the heading, and no form was assembled out of it.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (28 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 28 decembrie — «Sfântul Simon Izvorâtorul de mir, ctitorul Mănăstirii Simonos Petras»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Όσιος Σίμων ο Μυροβλήτης κτήτορας της Ιεράς Μονής Σιμωνόπετρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps on the Romanian calendar, and the entry is the same man: the founder of Simonopetra, led to the rock by a star on the night of the Nativity and a myrrh-streamer after his death. The page gives the death the folder had no year for — its head reads «(; - 1257)» and its text «τελείωσε τον βίο του σε προχωρημένη ηλικία στις 28 Δεκεμβρίου 1257 μ.Χ.», which is both the year and the day — and the `dates` object here is that and nothing more; no year of birth is given, only «προχωρημένη ηλικία». It prints two apolytikia and a kontakion, all three of which name him, and all three are taken; the second is marked «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον» and the first is printed ending in a comma, copied as the page has it. Its megalynarion and its oikos are not kinds this schema holds and are left. It names the writers of his life and his services — Isaias, Nikephoros of Chios, the monks Theophilos and Raphael, Nikodemos the Hagiorite, and the archimandrite Hieronymos Simonopetrites, who published the service in 1924 — which is authorship and not a relation, so none of them is linked or related. It names the Serbian despot John Uglješa (died 1371), who enlarged and enriched the monastery after the saint healed his child; the corpus holds no folder this reading could attach to him. It says his relic and his tomb are today hidden and unknown. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 10.01.2026 (28. децембар ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Симон Мироточиви.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, and THREE SENTENCES is the whole of it. Identified past any doubt and on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep him: the heading’s «Мироточиви» is the Μυροβλήτης and the Izvorâtorul de mir both his other rows print, and the first sentence names the house — «Оснивач светогорског манастира Симоно-Петра», founder of the Athonite monastery of Simonopetra — which is the one thing that tells this Simon from every other. THE YEAR AGREES EXACTLY and `dates` is therefore untouched: «Упокојио се мирно и прешао ка Христу 1257. године» against the flat 1257 the folder already holds off saint.gr’s «στις 28 Δεκεμβρίου 1257». `types` untouched: «Преподобни» is the `venerable` the folder carries, and `hermit` and `abbot` are there already off the other two books; «Мироточиви» is an epithet and not one of BRIEF.md §9’s types. No `office`. No `locations`: the folder has never had one, and a monastery named after its founder is not a coordinate. No `related`: the entry names no saint. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS is only a summary — «Прослављен подвизима, виђењима и чудесима», glorified by his ascetic labours, by visions and by wonders — which is three words where the folder’s existing life has pages, so the new paragraph says plainly that this book gives him three sentences and what they are. The Serbian form is the heading with the rank stripped and the epithet kept, «Симон Мироточиви», and it has no other holder; the bare «Симон» has none either, and the fuller form was written because §6 asks for the fullest the calendar gives. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «τελείωσε τον βίο του σε προχωρημένη ηλικία στις 28 Δεκεμβρίου 1257 μ.Χ.», with the page's own head «(; - 1257)». No year of birth is given, only that he died at an advanced age.

hymns.text: Τὸν περιλάλητον πιστοὶ Μυροβλύτην, καὶ πανυπέρτιμον Χριστοῦ μαργαρίτην, καὶ μοναζόντων ἔρεισμα, καὶ θεῖον ἀσκητήν, πάντες εὐφημήσωμεν, πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐκβοῶντες· Σίμων μάκαρ φύλαττε, ἐξ ἐχθρῶν ἐπηρείας· ἣν ἐδομήσω νέαν Βηθλεέμ, ὁδηγηθεὶς δι’ ἀστέρος τρισόλβιε,

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ΄ — the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Όσιος Σίμων ο Μυροβλήτης κτήτορας της Ιεράς Μονής Σιμωνόπετρας», and it names him. The page prints no model for this one, and its text ends in a comma, copied as it stands.

english.text: Faithful, let us all praise the far-renowned myrrh-streamer, the all-precious pearl of Christ, the prop of monks and the divine ascetic, crying out to him: blessed Simon, guard from the malice of enemies the New Bethlehem you built, having been led by a star, thrice-blessed one,

hymns.text: Τῇ ἀσκήσει ἐκλάμψας ἐν Ἄθῳ Ὅσιε, ὡς καθαρθεὶς τὴν καρδίαν τῶν ἀρετῶν τῷ φωτί, ἐδοξάσθης θαυμαστῶς Σίμων μακάριε· διὸ καὶ βλύζειν κρουνηδόν, μύρα εὔοσμα ἡμῖν, ἠξίωσαι μετὰ τέλος. Ἀλλὰ μὴ παύσῃ πρεσβεύων, ἐλεηθῆναι τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α’, Τὸν συνάναρχον Λόγον — the second of two apolytikia on the page of «Όσιος Σίμων ο Μυροβλήτης κτήτορας της Ιεράς Μονής Σιμωνόπετρας», and it names him.

english.text: Shining out in the ascetic life on Athos, venerable one, your heart cleansed by the light of the virtues, you were wonderfully glorified, blessed Simon; and so after your end you were counted worthy to pour out fragrant myrrh upon us in streams. Do not cease, then, to intercede that our souls may find mercy.

hymns.text: Ὡς τῶν Ὁσίων ἀνυμνοῦμέν σε ἀκρέμονα καὶ Ἀποστόλων ὀπαδόν καὶ ἰσοστάσιον καὶ τοῦ Ἄθω σεμνολόγημα καὶ φωστῆρα· Δὸς οὖν Πάτερ καὶ ἡμῖν τὴν σὴν ἀντίληψιν Ὑπέρ πάντων ἐξαιτούμενος τὸν Κύριον Τῶν βοώντων σοι, χαίροις Σίμων τρισόλβιε.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ — printed under «Όσιος Σίμων ο Μυροβλήτης κτήτορας της Ιεράς Μονής Σιμωνόπετρας», and it names him.

english.text: We hymn you as a chief branch among the venerable, a follower of the Apostles and their equal, the honour and the luminary of Athos. Give us too, father, your help, asking the Lord on behalf of all who cry to you: rejoice, thrice-blessed Simon.
